title: Terrible.
text: Terrible.. Tried multiple times and the eggs are undercooked. Used the suggested amount of water and it leaked out underneath it. There was also a large burn spot, which I'm sure was due to the lack of water (since it was all over my counter!) Would not recommend this product to anyone.
